statement: Current-source standalone torus-energy software validation on Rust1.100.0: release all-target checks pass four library, two identity-certificate and two scaling-model cases; cargo fmt check and strict release all-target Clippy pass after correcting an equivalent range-style lint. Complete hashes for30 source/manifest/fixture inputs are checked after validation, and the source-v4 post-check archive includes all three standalone crates plus their two imported root source modules. Prior immutable control archives and failed validation logs are preserved. These are producer software/byte checks, not independent signed execution, a performance comparison, sampling, a full-base solve or an actual attack exponent.
